shows.title: Reincarnation Research / Occult Influences
shows.first_half: First Half: Author and reincarnation researcher Stephen Sakellarios will discuss the evidence for reincarnation, his efforts to document a claimed past life, and his controversial research linking that lifetime to famous literary works, including A Christmas Carol and The Raven.
shows.second_half: Second Half: Researcher, podcast host, and founder of The Redpill Project, Joshua Reid delves into occult and esoteric traditions, hidden influences on world events, and alternative perspectives on history and human consciousness. He'll also share insights into the forces he believes shape society and humanity's evolving understanding of reality.

shows.title: Gratitude & Luck / The Mandela Effect
shows.guests: Dr. Joe Gallenberger, Cheryll Jones, Aage Nost
shows.first_half: First Half: Clinical psychologist and author Dr. Joe Gallenberger will discuss how gratitude can support healing and enhance manifestation. He'll share success stories from his Liquid Luck work, demonstrate practical applications of his techniques, and provide updates on his latest projects.
shows.second_half: Second Half: C2C's investigative reporter Cheryll Jones presents her interview with author and researcher Aage Nost. They'll explore the Mandela Effect, in which large numbers of people share mistaken memories of events or details, and examine how the concept of parallel realities may offer an explanation for the phenomenon.

shows.title: Akashic Records & Past Lives / Open Lines
shows.first_half: Joining guest host  Ryan Wrecker (email), past life regressionist and author Shelley A. Kaehr, Ph.D., will reveal how she first accessed the Akashic Records, which many believe to be a multidimensional source of spiritual insight and soul-level knowledge. She'll share techniques for exploring past lives and uncovering life journeys. Followed by Open Lines in the latter half. Give Ryan a call and discuss whatever's on your mind!
